title: Clinking Curio-Cuttle
statement: Nestled among sunken slate shelves and swaying kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days softly tapping shards of colorful sea glass into intricate, ever-changing mosaics on the sandy floor. Whenever a visitor leans close, it pauses its work and ripples with bright, conversational constellations of light, as if eagerly sharing a brand-new hypothesis.
